title: Sharp Convergence Rates and Optimal Weights for Cimmino's Reflection Algorithm
summary: In this paper, Cimmino's classical reflection algorithm for solving the $n\times n$ nonsingular linear system $A\bx=\bb$ is analysed through the lens of spectral theory. Reformulating the weighted iteration as $\e^{(ν+1)}=M_w\,\e^{(ν)}$, where $M_w = I - A^\top D_w A$, the error is shown to contract by the spectral radius $\sprad(M_w)$ at every step, with a sharp, asymptotically tight bound.
